# Create a Map

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Create a Map

To use maps, we must first include the map header file in our program.

```cpp
#include <map>
```

We can then create a map by using the following syntax:

```cpp
map<key_type, value_type> map_name;
```

Here,

- key_type is the data type of the key
- value_type is the data type of the value

For example,

```cpp
map<int, string> students;
```

Here,

- key_type is int
- value_type is string

![Map in C++](data:image/png;base64,)

Since every element of a map is a key/value pair, we have to provide both keys and values while inserting an element.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
